story.title: 'Scene' vs 'Mookuthi Amman 2' BO Day 1 [Live]: Suriya starrer takes the lead
story.summary: Suriya's action-packed thriller 'Scene' and Nayanthara's captivating fantasy sequel 'Mookuthi Amman 2' are set for release in cinemas on November 6, just in time for the Diwali holiday weekend.
